scope.note: Dimensions and conditional fit calculations only. No contact FEA, certified preload, female-thread stripping or frame-slot proof completed.

pocket.note: Uniform 0.12 outward offset from published bracket analytic profile; all functional wall segments controlled. Cable cutouts excluded.

rear_counterbore.purpose: Floating small steel washer; bottom must support washer without burrs. Opening near the cable relief is intentional if encountered.
rear_counterbore.axis_basic_location: Same basic X/Z coordinates as the three clearance holes; counterbore included in position control.

cable.note: STEP wire diameter is not a supplier cable tolerance. Verify actual bundle, insulation, bend radius and relief center placement.

frame_holes.note: Center screw/nut to clearance hole; underhead fillet seating is an inspection item, not guaranteed from a cylinder-only collision model.

B.feature: Motor endface seating plane, local Y18

C.feature: Derived median plane of outside local X0/X90 faces

datums.note: Basic XYZ and contour coordinates locate to A|B|C. Do not add a second +/-0.05 pocket-axis error on top of surface-profile total zone.

motor_source_limits.note: PCD tolerance alone does not prove hole-angle, boss concentricity or complete hole-pattern position. Lot gauging remains required. Do not reuse DDSM115 depth6.

conditional_fit.purpose: Approximate translational seating envelope from straight-flat and large-arc extrema, conditional on full-profile inspection and parallel endfaces
limitations: Upward seating can occur on an inclined flat before the top arc.
This is not an all-direction contact or rotational backlash proof.
Actual x translation, angular seating, entry chamfers and blended corners require actual-profile and three-screw assembly gauging.
Adjust caster contact based on measured installed height and loaded tire deflection; CAD nominal contact is not physical contact certification.

screw.specification: M2.5 x 0.45 x 12, JIS B1176, strength class12.9, SCM435, black oxide, full thread

washer.acceptance_target_standard: JIS B1256 small-series gradeA / ISO7092 dimensional limits
washer.note: Areas are ideal flat-contact screening values after full seating; washer bending, edge chamfers, coatings, hardness and preload not qualified. Centering and full support inspection required.

stack.note: Depth5 is a published thread callout, not a measured hard bottom or guaranteed usable full-thread length. Measure usable depth and incomplete threads. No torque inferred from property class.

screw.specification: M6 x 1 x 12, JIS B1176, class12.9, SCM435, black oxide

nut.body_shape: Tapered body toward groove bottom; not a rectangular15x14x5.5 block

extrusion.bottom_shape: Sloping cavity walls and model-specific slot-bottom detail; depth9 is nominal deepest depth
extrusion.old_CAD_error: 8mm mouth/3mm lip/13mm cavity/8mm depth and 12.8-square t4 nut were simplified incorrectly

mount_chain.note: These intervals exclude actual nut/nose/lip tolerances, female thread lead, groove bottom projection and clamping deformation. Effective engagement is not5.8 by definition.

frame_fasteners.note: The manufacturer's11.7Nm nut reference torque is not adopted as the torque for this thin aluminum bracket/slot joint.

verification_gates.required: Vendor acknowledges both drawing pages and basic STEP; inspect full profile0.10 and hole-position0.10 to common datums. Record actual motor fit and hole pattern.

Seat to upward load contour, inspect three screws inserted without forcing, full endface contact, washer/fillet fit and cable clearance. Confirm female thread material, usable full engagement and torque/preload before strength qualification.
Use actual HNTT6/NFSL cross sections. Measure lip/slot/nut/bolt/clamped stack, verify no bottoming, complete head seating, effective thread engagement and access before assembly release.
Evaluate contact pressure, washer bending, thread stripping, preload, prying and groove-lip pullout for accepted load cases. SF2 is unproven; static CAD collision absence does not satisfy it.

Do not apply245.16625N or490.3325N fixture load through a motor solely because the mount is tested. Use a separately reviewed representative dummy boss/fixture; motor catalogradial120N/axial60N has a different scope.
